title: Isolation of human intrahepatic leukocytes for phenotypic and functional characterization by flow cytometry
protocol: Remove liver tissue from its preservation solution.
Dissect liver tissue into sections no greater than 3.5 × 3.5 × 3.5 cm using blunt-ended scissors and forceps.
Reserve the preservation solution for later use.
Place each dissected section of liver (approximately 43 cm³, ∼30 g) in a 100 mL universal beaker.
Top up the beaker with 25 mL pre-warmed enzyme digestion buffer.
Dissect larger sections of liver into small pieces no greater than 5 × 5 × 5 mm using blunt-ended scissors against the side of the beaker.
Incubate the chopped tissue at 37°C for 30 minutes, swirling the beaker every 10 minutes.
Dissect liver into pieces no greater than 5 × 5 × 5 mm (125 mm³).
Place dissected liver pieces in a 100 mL universal beaker containing pre-warmed enzyme digestion buffer.
Incubate liver pieces with enzymes for 30 minutes at an appropriate temperature.
Transfer the enzyme-digested tissue and remaining enzyme digestion buffer into a gentleMACSTM C-tube, not exceeding the maximum volume of 10 ml/C-tube.
Place each C-tube on a gentleMACSTM tissue dissociator and run one cycle using the mouse spleen program: m_spleen_01.01 (length: 50 s).
Place a 70 μm cell strainer on a new 50 mL conical tube and rinse with 1 mL 1× HBSS−/−.
Pour the contents of each C-tube into the cell strainer.
Rinse the cell strainer with 1 mL 1× HBSS−/− before pouring tissue.
Grind the remaining liver tissue through the cell strainer using the flat end of a sterile plunger from a 5 mL syringe.
Wash the cell strainer with 1–2 mL 1× HBSS−/− regularly to prevent clogging and to help ease IHL through.
Once the 50 mL conical tube reaches a volume of 25 mL, remove the cell strainer.
Top up the conical tube with an additional 25 mL HBSS−/− to prevent over-concentration of cells.
Centrifuge cells within 10 min of grinding through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Repeat steps until all tissue is processed and IHL liberated.
Centrifuge the single-cell suspension at 700 g using a swing bucket rotor for 15 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant using a 25 mL serological pipette.
Harvest the layer of fat floating on top of the conical tube with a Pasteur pipette and discard if necessary.
Continue to remove and discard the remaining supernatant carefully.
Vortex the remaining cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 20 mL of 30% Percoll® solution in a 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the Percoll®-IHL solution at 800 g using a swing bucket rotor for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the top layer of contaminating hepatocytes using a sterile Pasteur pipette and discard.
Gently remove the remaining supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Vortex the cell pellet to resuspend it in 25 mL of 1× HBSS−/−.
Gently layer 25 mL of the IHL single-cell suspension over 12.5 mL of Pancoll in a new 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the layered samples at 800 g using a swing bucket rotor for 20 min at room temperature (acceleration/deceleration: low / OFF).
Harvest the IHL layer at the interface of the 1× HBSS−/− and Pancoll gradient using a Pasteur pipette.
Transfer the harvested IHL layer to a new 50 mL conical tube.
Collect the IHL layer indicated by the black arrow using a clean Pasteur pipette.
Dilute the collected IHL in RPMI-1640 to a final volume of 50 mL.
Centrifuge the diluted IHL solution at 700 g using swing buckets for 15 minutes at room temperature (acceleration/deceleration: 9/9).
Aspirate and discard the supernatant with a 25 mL serological pipette without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the IHL pellet in an appropriate volume of complete RPMI-1640 for cell counting.
Pause the process after resuspending the pellet.
Centrifuge the isolated IHL suspension at 700 g for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the resulting pellet in freezing media.
Aliquot the resuspended pellet into cryovials.
Place cryovials into a Mr.FrostyTM freezing container in the -80°C freezer.
Transfer cryovials to liquid nitrogen after 24 hours for long-term storage.
Thaw IHL using pre-warmed 1× HBSS+/+ media supplemented with 0.002% DNase I.
Incubate the thawed sample in 20-25 mL of DNase I supplemented 1× HBSS+/+ at 37°C for 10-15 minutes.
Centrifuge the incubated sample at 700 g for 10 minutes at room temperature (acceleration/deceleration: 9/9).
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in DNase I supplemented 1× HBSS+/+ media.
Incubate resuspended sample in DNase I supplemented 1× HBSS+/+ at 37°C for an additional 10 minutes.
Prepare LIVE/DEADTM Fixable Dead Cell Stain solution in 1× PBS at a dilution factor of 1 in 1,000.
Prepare antibody master mixes in a 50:50 mix of 1× PBS and BD Brilliant Stain Buffer.
Protect the antibody master mixes from light to prevent artifact generation.
Add LIVE/DEADTM Fixable Dead Cell Stain directly to the antibody master mix for combined staining.
Optimize the concentration of LIVE/DEADTM Stain for better separation of live and dead cells when stained separately.
Transfer IHL in a maximum volume of 200 μL per well into a 96 well U-bottom tissue culture treated plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 g at 4°C for 4 min.
Gently discard the supernatant, being careful not to disturb the cell pellet.
Resuspend cells in 50 μL of LIVE/DEADTM Stain solution per well.
Incubate the stained cells for either 15 minutes at room temperature or 30 minutes at 4°C, protected from light.
Supplement each well with 150 μL of 1× PBS.
Centrifuge the plate again at 500 g at 4°C for 4 min.
Optional: Prepare FcR Block as per manufacturer’s instructions and add 25 μL/well prior to staining cells with surface antibodies for optimal B cell staining.
Incubate samples in FcR Block for 10 min at 4°C.
Gently discard the supernatant and resuspend cells in 50 μl of antibody master mix prepared previously.
Incubate cells for 30 min at 4°C protected from light.
Supplement each well with 150 μl 1× PBS, centrifuge at 500 g at 4°C for 4 min, and discard the supernatant gently.
Resuspend cell pellet in 100 μl BD CytofixTM buffer per well by pipetting up and down to avoid clumping.
Incubate cells for 20 min at 4°C protected from light.
Supplement each well with 100 μl 1× PBS, centrifuge at 500 g at 4°C for 4 min, and discard the supernatant gently.
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μl 1× PBS ready for acquisition by flow cytometry.
Pause the experiment after staining samples.
Store stained samples at 4°C and protected from light until analysis.
Place a 1.2 mL ‘small insert’ tube containing the stained cells inside a FACS tube to reduce residual volume.
Analyze data using an appropriate flow cytometer running BD FACSDiva v. 9.0.1.
Acquire data for samples placed in 96-well plates using a HTS sample coupler if available.
Analyze acquired data using FlowJo v. 10 software.
For complex staining, refer to the specific staining protocol (Cossarizza et al., 2021).
